faq.question: How long does custom software development take?
faq.answer: Discovery takes 2 to 4 weeks. Builds ship in phases after that, each built around one real workflow.

faq.question: Can you extend our existing software product?
faq.answer: Yes. We audit the codebase first, then plan safe, staged changes so nothing breaks while it improves.

faq.question: What does a software development scope look like?
faq.answer: One clear workflow per phase, with outcomes agreed before we start.

cta.p: A 15 minute fit call. We bring a first read of where your product loses users.
